decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is commenced a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to the education centre shall have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The agreed scheme shall be implemented before the development hereby permitted is brought into use.

Condition : 4 - The use as an education centre shall not commence until a scheme to protect the safety and security of clientele entering and leaving the building has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
description: Change of use of offices on third floor to classroom use.
